newsitem.title: USA: AVECOR blood pump cleared by FDA for sale.
newsitem.headline: AVECOR blood pump cleared by FDA for sale.

text.p: AVECOR Cardiovascular Inc said Tuesday it received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its new AFFINITY blood pump.
The company said its pump offers better blood-handling characteristics and cost advantages over the centrifugal pumps and roller pumps currently used in heart/lung bypass surgery.

"The new pump is currently in production at our Minneapolis facility and we began selling it in Europe late in the second quarter," said Anthony Badolato, AVECOR chief executive. "Our U.S. market introduction will begin immediately, but we do not expect significant sales from the new product in the third quarter," he said in a news release.
"Over the longer term, we expect that the pump will have a positive effect on sales of our entire product line," he added.
AVECOR develops, makes and markets specialty disposable medical devices for heart/lung bypass surgery and long-term respiratory support.
Shares of AVECOR were trading up 3/4 to 11-1/4.
